newsitem.title: UK: Ousted Scottish minister steps out of politics.
newsitem.headline: Ousted Scottish minister steps out of politics.

text.p: Michael Forsyth, Scottish minister in the Conservative government that suffered a crushing defeat in Thursday's national election, said on Friday he was stepping down from politics.
Forsyth's seat was one of the Conservatives' 10 in Scotland which it lost in the election, leaving it with no members of parliament for the region.
He told a news conference that he would "play no part in politics in the foreseeable future." However, he said he would remain a member of the Scottish Conservative Party.
"I am very sad for all my colleagues," Forsyth said. "We've seen the obliteration of our party in Scotland.
